secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app id of the hosted backend this frontend talks to. Find it in the Base44 editor URL: app.base44.com/apps/<app-id>/editor. Without it every /api call 404s and the app can only render the login screen.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Base URL of your published Base44 app (frontend + /api backend share this origin), e.g. https://<app-id>.base44.app, with no trailing slash. Vite proxies /api to it. Without it the app logs '[base44] No Base44 backend configured' and no data loads.
